---
title: "NHANES Dashboard"
author: "Hamed"
date: "2026-10-04"
output:
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    self_contained: true
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE)

local_lib <- normalizePath(
  file.path("..", "..", ".r-lib"),
  mustWork = FALSE
)
if (dir.exists(local_lib)) {
  .libPaths(c(local_lib, .libPaths()))
}
if (!requireNamespace("pacman", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("pacman")
}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, flexdashboard, here)

hanes <- read_csv(
  here("data", "cleaned_NHANES.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
) %>%
  mutate(
    readings_available = rowSums(
      !is.na(across(starts_with("systolic_bp_")))
    ),
    avg_sbp = rowMeans(
      across(starts_with("systolic_bp_")),
      na.rm = TRUE
    ),
    avg_sbp = if_else(
      readings_available == 0,
      NA_real_,
      avg_sbp
    )
  )

adult_percent <- round(mean(hanes$age >= 21, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)

high_sbp_percent <- round(
  mean(hanes$avg_sbp > 120, na.rm = TRUE) * 100,
  1
)
```

Row {data-height=650}
-------------------------------------

### Age distribution in the NHANES sample

```{r age-figure, out.width="95%"}
knitr::include_graphics(
  here("figures", "A_age_distribution.png")
)
```

Row {data-height=350}
-------------------------------------

### Participants aged 21 or older

```{r adult-gauge}
gauge(
  adult_percent,
  min = 0,
  max = 100,
  symbol = "%",
  sectors = gaugeSectors(
    success = c(65, 100),
    warning = c(40, 65),
    danger = c(0, 40)
  )
)
```

### Average SBP above 120 mm Hg

```{r sbp-value-box}
valueBox(
  paste0(high_sbp_percent, "%"),
  caption = "Participants with average systolic BP above 120 mm Hg",
  icon = "fa-heartbeat",
  color = "danger"
)
```
